title: Delhi Traffic Police enforcement figures, 2019 to 2022, as printed in the annual reports
scope: Delhi citywide; not split by district. Counts, not rates.
caveats: Citywide counts. Prosecutions and notices depend on enforcement effort and on how many cameras were working, not only on behaviour.

Drink-driving prosecutions fell from 36,065 (2019) to 3,986 (2020); the 2020 and 2021 reports say alcometer tests were reduced because of the pandemic. The 2023 and 2024 figures in road_safety_extra_2023_2024.json (15,972 and 22,952) are about seven times the 2022 figure, and this repository has not established whether the counting basis is the same. Do not read the jump as a change in drinking and driving.
Over-speeding notices come from OSVD and tripod-mounted cameras. The 2019 value is read from the 2020 report, which prints it as the previous year.

Camera counts are not given: the 2020 to 2022 reports say 37 red-light-camera junctions and 100 speed-camera locations, the 2021 report elsewhere says 125 OSVD cameras at 66 locations and 43 RLVD junctions, and the 2023 and 2024 values (209 and 125 systems) use a third basis. They are left blank for 2019 to 2022 rather than reconciled.
Hit-and-run share for 2022 is computed here (668 of 1,428); the other shares are printed.

Values were read from the PDF text layers. Three (drink-driving 2019, over-speeding 2019 and 2020) were also checked on the page image; none has had an independent second review. No open reuse licence has been verified.
